name: Sign Rank / Dual Sign Rank
proof: If a fixed set of $k$ columns is linearly independent in every realizing matrix, then every realizing matrix has rank at least $k$.  Thus the maximum such fixed $k$ (dual sign rank) is at most sign rank.
witness_verification: For $\mathcal U_n$, $\mathrm{SR}(\mathcal U_n)=n$, whereas Proposition 1 gives $\mathrm{DSR}(\mathcal U_n)\leq 2\lfloor\log_2 n\rfloor+1$.  Hence the gap is unbounded.
